import random
r = random.Random(1)
jobs = []
for i in range(30):
    rel = r.randint(0, 20)
    jobs.append(('j%d' % i, rel, r.randint(1, 4), r.randint(0, 3), None if r.random() < 0.5 else rel + r.randint(0, 10)))
result = sol.schedule(jobs)

cases.name: stress_all_at_once
cases.code:
import random
r = random.Random(11)
jobs = [('j%06d' % i, 0, r.randint(1, 5), r.randint(0, 50), None if i % 3 else r.randint(0, 300000)) for i in range(200000)]
runs, dropped = sol.schedule(jobs)
result = (len(runs), len(dropped), runs[-1], sum(s for _, s, _ in runs) % 1000000007, runs[:3], dropped[:5])

cases.name: stress_waves
cases.code:
import random
r = random.Random(12)
jobs = [('w%06d' % i, (i // 1000) * 2500, r.randint(1, 4), r.randint(0, 9), None if r.random() < 0.7 else (i // 1000) * 2500 + r.randint(0, 3000)) for i in range(200000)]
r.shuffle(jobs)
runs, dropped = sol.schedule(jobs)
result = (len(runs), len(dropped), runs[-1], sum((k + 1) * s for k, (_, s, _) in enumerate(runs)) % 1000000007, runs[::20011])
